title: File search scope
description: Searches enabled NTFS volumes; exclude a folder or a whole volume.
queryOnly: These settings control your filename and content queries. They do not stop or change the machine-wide search service index.
pathHelp: Enter one absolute path per line, such as C:\ or D:\Archive. Leave empty to retain only the host's private data exclusions and the service defaults.
saving: Cancelling the previous query and saving…
applyHelp: Saving invalidates the current query and its old results. New queries use the updated scope immediately.
previewHelp: The matching line is highlighted. This preview displays plain text and never executes file content.
extensionsHelp: Leave empty for the default text, Markdown, and code formats, or enter extensions such as md, txt, ts. PDF and Office are excluded.
includeHidden: Include hidden files and directories in content queries
serviceHelp: These controls change the machine-wide index. Applying or rebuilding requires confirmation and Windows administrator authorization, separately from your query filters above.
servicePathHelp: One local subdirectory per line, such as D:\Archive. To exclude an entire volume, turn off its switch. Default system exclusions are preserved.
workspaceContentPlaceholder: Search text, Markdown, and code files
emptyPromptHelp: Names, paths, and pinyin initials are supported
emptyHelp: Try another keyword or a different category
serviceMissingTitle: The file search service is not installed
serviceMissingHelp: Install it to use the default NTFS volumes and exclusions. Administrator approval is required.
serviceUpdateTitle: The search service needs an update
serviceUpdateHelp: Switching versions requires administrator authorization; ordinary queries never upgrade it.
staleHelp: Old pages are invalid. Search again.
